from cyhole.jupiter import Jupiter
from cyhole.jupiter.client import GetSwapOrderParams, PostSwapExecuteBody

# Initialize Jupiter client (lite tier doesn't require API key)
jupiter = Jupiter()
client = jupiter.client

# Token addresses on Solana
SOL_MINT = "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"  # Wrapped SOL
USDC_MINT = "EPjFWaJfkxQ9sPbY1pV45kzWmhKvDz9CuaYfWHRcL9Bg"  # USDC
USER_PUBLIC_KEY = "YourSolanaWalletPublicKeyHere"  # Replace with actual wallet

    output_mint=USDC_MINT,

    user_public_key=USER_PUBLIC_KEY
)

print("Requesting swap quote...")

# Step 2: Execute the swap using the quote

)

swap_result = client.post_swap_execute(swap_execute_body)
print(f"Swap executed successfully!")
